sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Online Merchant Acquiring and Clearing Service Provider (PSP)

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Romano-Germanic tradition) with a strong constitutional court; commercial governance codified in the Código de Comercio and Ley 1258 of 2008
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia–United States Trade Promotion Agreement (in force 2012)
Colombia–European Union Free Trade Agreement (provisionally applied since 2013)
Colombia–South Korea Free Trade Agreement (in force 2016)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 526 of 1999 (UIAF creation); Law 1121 of 2006 (AML/CFT regime); Law 1258 of 2008 (S.A.S. structure); Law 2017 of 2020, Article 36 (beneficial owner registry mandate); Executive Decree 830 of 2021 (SARLAFT consolidation); Financial Superintendence of Colombia External Circular 029 of 2014, Chapter IV (SARLAFT instructions for supervised entities)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation for a corporate shareholder (Certificate of Good Standing)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent commercial registry official in the shareholder's country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the issuing country; if that country is not a Hague Convention member, consular legalization by the Colombian Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the corporate shareholder's charter, bylaws, or articles of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry, notary, or government-chartered registrar in the jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization through the Colombian Ministry of Foreign Affairs

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Audited financial statements or equivalent balance-sheet evidence of the corporate shareholder demonstrating economic capacity and source of funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Independent statutory auditor or competent accounting authority in the jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization, with official translation into Spanish by a Colombian certified translator

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate power of attorney appointing the Colombian local representative for the S.A.S. incorporation and regulatory filings
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the jurisdiction of the appointing shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; notarization protocol checked by the receiving Colombian notary

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of the Ultimate Beneficial Owner's passport or national identity document with specimen signature
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization, accompanied by an exact Spanish translation if issued in a foreign language

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all direct and indirect shareholders, UBOs, directors, and persons holding control or significant influence against the OFAC SDN List, the United Nations Consolidated List, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and Colombia's UIAF 'Listas Vinculantes' per Executive Decree 830 of 2021. PEP status is determined by country of residence and function; positive PEP or sanctions hits trigger enhanced due diligence, escalation to the compliance committee, and a Suspicious Transaction Report (ROS) to UIAF before formal incorporation of the S.A.S.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) through the local Cámara de Comercio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá accessible at rues.org.co and ccborg.org)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be expressed in Spanish and may incorporate foreign words only where transliterated into Spanish script or demonstrably used as a registered trademark; the legal and statutory type designation 'S.A.S.' or 'Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada' must appear in the corporate name; the name must be distinguishable from all existing registered names and must not create confusion with regulated financial sector entities or public institutions.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Sociedad de Depósito y Pago Electrónico (SEDPE)
Nacional (when implying public ownership or authority)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Cámara de Comercio rejects a name request, the interested party may file a 'recurso de reposición' with the same Chamber within five (5) business days from notification; if that is denied, a 'recurso de apelación' may be filed within five (5) business days before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC). The name reservation cannot be extended past the initial 30-day window, but a new reservation for a different name may be filed simultaneously or immediately after exhaustion of administrative remedies.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not acceptable as the principal registered office for a regulated payment service provider. The S.A.S. must maintain a physical operational address in Colombia with identifiable premises, local staff, and demonstrable commercial substance; virtual offices or agent addresses may be used only as secondary service-of-process notification addresses.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Probability of unannounced physical on-site inspection within the first 12 months of registration is 80% for a high-risk PSP/SEDPE applicant; the Superintendence of Finance (SFC), UIAF, and the local Chamber of Commerce routinely conduct documentary and physical verification of the registered office during the licensing phase and after issuance of a temporary authorization.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and homologation reservation through the RUES portal
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio (local chamber, e.g., Bogotá)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under Decree 1074 of 2015 and Chamber of Commerce fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of the S.A.S. incorporation document and UBO affidavit
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary Public in the registered domicile city
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notary tariff schedule authorized by the Superintendence of Notaries and Registry

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial registration filing of the S.A.S. deed and ancillary documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry tariff plus Chamber internal fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Batch apostille and consular legalization of foreign shareholder documents (4 documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Colombia and competent foreign apostille authorities
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official apostille fee schedule of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Spanish translation of foreign corporate, financial, and UBO documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark per translated folio

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO declaration initial compilation and pre-filing review
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External compliance counsel and DIAN/RUFB filing preparation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for AML compliance services

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal opinion on payment-gateway licensing pathway (SEDPE/PSP authorization under Law 1735 of 2014)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for FinTech and banking regulatory opinions

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT pre-incorporation compliance manual, risk matrix, and SARLAFT gap analysis
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Independent compliance consultant or law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for regulated PSP compliance programs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Initial subscription and screening results for PEP and sanctions databases (OFAC, UN, EU, UIAF lists)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Vendor subscription fee for the first quarter

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and registration of the local agent power of attorney with the Chamber
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary Public and Cámara de Comercio
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notary and Chamber fee schedule

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedades por Acciones Simplificadas, arts. 1-49), Código de Comercio de Colombia (arts. 110-113, 373, 376), Decreto 2555 de 2010 (régimen de proveedores de servicios de pago de bajo valor), Ley 527 de 1999 (comercio electrónico y mensajes de datos), Ley 222 de 1995 (supervisión)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (registro RUES - Registro Único Empresarial y Social)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución registrado ante la Cámara de Comercio (sin escritura pública salvo aportes inmobiliarios)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No mínimo legal de capital para S.A.S.; la suscripción total del capital autorizado es obligatoria y el pago puede diferirse hasta dos años desde la suscripción (Ley 1258/2008, art. 17). Para licencia de pasarela de pago, la SFC exige patrimonio mínimo orientado de aproximadamente USD 310,000 (COP 1,200 millones), indexado anualmente por resolución de la SFC
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, under Ley 1258 de 2008 and the bylaws: FIRST, the share subscription is ratified; the full subscribed capital is allocated among founding shareholders per the accounting entry, payable within the statutory two-year period. SECOND, the registered office set out in the constitutive instrument is adopted, with domicile in Bogotá D.C., Colombia. THIRD, the following officers are appointed: Legal Representative, Alternate Legal Representative, and Company Secretary, with powers under the bylaws. FOURTH, the Legal Representative is empowered to execute filings with the Chamber of Commerce, DIAN, and Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia, including the payment-gateway authorization, and to represent the company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company name availability check and homonymy certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio correspondiente / portal RUES (www.rues.org.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online application through RUES to verify that the proposed corporate name (razón social) is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered company. The system generates a certificate of homonymy for a single name; if rejected, the applicant must provide alternative names. Fee payment is made electronically through PSE.
required_dossiers: Formulario único de registro (FUR) pre-liquidado
Copia de cédula de ciudadanía o pasaporte del solicitante
Lista de hasta cinco denominaciones alternativas
Pago de derechos de búsqueda de homonimia
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber of Commerce rejects the name due to coincidence or misleading similarity, file a written reconsideration request indicating the distinguishing factors; if still adverse, select the next alternative name and restart the check.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and execution of the private incorporation instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública (para autenticación de firmas, si se opta) y abogado corporativo inscrito
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución per Ley 1258 de 2008, including articles of incorporation, corporate purpose (including payment gateway services), capital structure, class and series of shares, board composition, governance rules, shareholder name and address, registered office, and duration. The instrument must be signed by all founding shareholders with fingerprint and valid identification; signatures may be authenticated before a notary to expedite registration.
required_dossiers: Identificación oficial de cada accionista (cédula o pasaporte)
Certificado de homonimia favorable emitido por RUES
Poder autenticado en caso de comparecencia por apoderado
Proyecto de estatutos y documento de constitución
Declaración de origen lícito de los aportes
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary refuses authentication due to formal defects, correct the instrument to comply with Código de Comercio arts. 110-113 and Ley 1258/2008, resubmit for signature authentication, and request a new homonymy certificate if more than one month has elapsed since issuance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of the incorporation instrument with the Chamber of Commerce (RUES)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá D.C. (o cámara territorial del domicilio) - sistema RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the signed private instrument, completed FUR forms, and RUT draft through RUES. Pay the registration fee, mercantile registration contribution, and form processing fees. The Chamber verifies the name, legal provisions, capital payment documentation, and appointing clauses; upon approval, it issues the certificado de existencia y representación legal.
required_dossiers: Documento privado de constitución firmado
Formulario FUR de matrícula mercantil
Borrador del Registro Único Tributario (RUT)
Pago de derechos de inscripción, registro y contribución
Poder y copia de identidad del representante legal
Certificado de homonimia
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber issues an observación (query), the applicant receives an electronic notification; any omissions, calculation errors, or legal inconsistencies must be corrected within 8 business days through RUES, and the file is automatically reactivated. Persistent rejection can be appealed under Código de Procedimiento Administrativo (CPACA).

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN - Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (Oficina Virtual)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Chamber issues the certificate, file the RUT registration within 30 days to obtain the NIT. The S.A.S. will be classified as responsable del impuesto sobre la renta and will be entered into the census of financial technology service providers. Bank account, invoice numbering (facturación), and e-commerce billing parameters are configured.
required_dossiers: Certificado de existencia y representación legal emitido por la Cámara de Comercio
Formulario oficial de inscripción RUT (preliquidado por la CC)
Cédula del representante legal
Poder autenticado cuando exista apoderado
Prueba de dirección del domicilio fiscal
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN requires clarifications, submit a written response through DIAN Virtual with supporting documents; in case of erroneous tax classification, file an update (actualización del RUT) and a request for reconsideration before the DIAN Division of Registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Rubrication and ledger legalization of corporate books
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the mandatory corporate books to the Chamber of Commerce for stamping/rubrication: libro de actas, libro de registro de accionistas, and accounting books. The Chamber verifies that the first board resolution is recorded in the actas book and that the share allocation appears correctly in the shareholder registry. Books must be of a supported type and contain a seal and folio numbers.
required_dossiers: Libros de actas, registro de accionistas y contabilidad
Certificado de existencia y representación legal con fecha de expedición inferior a un mes
Acta de la primera asamblea o resolución de junta de socios rubricada
Comprobante de pago de derechos de rubricación
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber rejects the books due to alterations, pagination errors, or missing folios, correct the defects and present new books for a second rubrication; a rejected certificate can be renewed online to avoid expiry delays.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate governance adoption and regulatory pre-filing for payment gateway authorization
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) - Sistema de Documentos Electrónicos (SDE) y sede electrónica
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Adopt the corporate governance package: board manual, conflict-of-interest policy, PTEE/SARLAFT manual, AML/KYC procedures, information security policy, and internal audit function. Then submit the pre-filing application for authorization to operate as a payment service provider / payment gateway under Decreto 2555 de 2010. This includes business plan, financial projections, capital certification, ownership structure, and technology compliance documentation.
required_dossiers: Formulario de solicitud de autorización ante la SFC
Plan de negocio y proyecciones financieras a tres años
Manual de cumplimiento PTEE/SARLAFT y AML/KYC
Código de gobierno corporativo y manual de conflictos de interés
Certificado de patrimonio mínimo emitido por el revisor fiscal
Estructura de accionistas y declaración de origen de fondos
Documentación de seguridad de la información y certificaciones ISO 27001 si se tienen
Acta de asamblea que aprueba la operación de pasarela de pago
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the SFC issues a requerimiento técnico, respond within the granted statutory term (usually 10 business days) with supplemental information; if the license is denied, the applicant may file a reposición y apelación under CPACA and correct material deficiencies in the business model.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) - Delegatura de Riesgo y Supervisión Financiera; Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) para protección de datos y Registro Nacional de Bases de Datos
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorización Especial para operar como Proveedor de Servicios de Pago de Bajo Valor y Pasarela de Pago (Decreto 2555 de 2010, Parte 2, Título 6) e inscripción en el Registro Nacional de Bases de Datos ante la SIC (Ley 1581 de 2012)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) y Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente de Bogotá D.C.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Categoría administrativa - Actividad solo tecnológica/oficinas: exenta de licencia ambiental integral; requiere registro de generador de residuos peligrosos, inscripción de fuentes fijas de emisión y concepto sanitario ambiental para la sede
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Vertimientos de aguas residuales no domésticas conforme Resolución 0631 de 2015 (DBO5 ≤ 120 mg/L; DQO ≤ 180 mg/L; SST ≤ 60 mg/L); calidad del aire y emisiones de equipos de respaldo conforme Resolución 2254 de 2017; gestión de residuos peligrosos y RAEE conforme Decreto 4741 de 2005 y Resolución 1512 de 2010; normativa de campos electromagnéticos conforme Resolución 2806 de 2021 del MinTIC/MinSalud

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Certificado del Cuerpo de Bomberos (sistemas de extinción, salidas de emergencia, gabinetes); concepto técnico estructural e inspección sísmica (NSR-10); programa de salud ocupacional y Sistema de Gestión de Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo (SG-SST) conforme Ley 1562 de 2012 y Decreto 1072 de 2015; afiliación a ARL; certificado de uso de suelo y concepto de Plan de Ordenamiento Territorial de Bogotá (DPAE)

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN); official portals: www.dian.gov.co, www.muisca.dian.gov.co (MUISCA virtual taxpayer office for filings, RUT, e-invoicing API and DES submission).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1) Incorporate the S.A.S. by private deed or notarial instrument, register the company in the Cámara de Comercio of the corporate domicile, and obtain the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal. 2) Appoint a legal representative resident in Colombia and designate a local fiscal address; non-resident shareholders may hold 100% of equity without minimum capital. 3) Submit the Formulario de Inscripción en el Registro Único Tributario (RUT) to DIAN, identifying the entity as Responsable del Régimen Común for IVA and Régimen Ordinario for income tax; the system assigns the Número de Identificación Tributaria (NIT) as the unified tax ID, normally validated within 48 business hours. 4) Request the electronic signature mechanism (Firma Electrónica via DIAN-provided certificates or certified technical operators) that is mandatory for the legal representative to sign e-invoices, DES, and periodic returns. 5) Register the S.A.S. as an exporter of services through the MUISCA 'Régimen de Exportación de Servicios' option; foreign shareholders must also register themselves in the RUT on a non-domiciled basis (NIT for foreign entities) and designate a DIAN agent for procedural notifications.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia does not apply a check-the-box regime; the S.A.S. is a separate juridical person taxed at entity level. Available elections and mechanisms: (a) optional Régimen Simple de Tributación (SIMPLE) under Law 1943/2018 for gross income below 100,000 UVT (approx. COP 4,955,400,000 in 2024), combining income tax, VAT components, and industry-and-trade tax in one return, although high-risk payment processing activities are usually outside SIMPLE eligibility; (b) DIAN discretionary classification as Gran Contribuyente for large taxpayers; (c) election for the recognition of a foreign headquarters' Establecimiento Permanente under arts. 20-1 and 20-2 E.T. when the Colombian operation is only auxiliary (not relevant for a full S.A.S. booking all service income); (d) advance pricing agreements (APAs) and safe-harbor options under the Colombian transfer-pricing rules (arts. 260-10 to 260-11 E.T.); (e) CFC/hybrid rules apply mandatorily under Law 2277/2022 without elective exclusion, but a taxpayer may elect to present self-correction and extended documentation to mitigate hybrid mismatch penalties.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Impuesto al Valor Agregado (IVA) — Colombian Value Added Tax (VAT)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No turnover threshold for legal persons; a S.A.S. must register as an IVA responsible from the date of constitution and issuance of the RUT. The simplified VAT regime (permitting invoicing without itemized IVA and without monthly declaration) is reserved exclusively for natural persons with gross annual income below 3,500 UVT (COP 173,439,000 approx. for fiscal year 2024, based on UVT = COP 49,554), and is not available to the S.A.S. Consequently, VAT registration and monthly/periodic filing are mandatory irrespective of revenue from day one.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing under DIAN Resolution 000165/2023: the taxpayer must issue Factura Electrónica de Venta (FEV) through the Validación Previa (pre-clearance) model, transmitting the invoice dataset in near-real time via REST/SOAP API either directly or through a certified Proveedor Tecnológico; DIAN validates, assigns the CUNE unique electronic invoice code and a QR code, and returns authorization before the transaction can be delivered to the customer. The FEV is mandatory for all sales and export services, including cross-border payment gateway fees. Credit and debit notes also require DIAN pre-validation. The local technical infrastructure and datacenter must be usable by DIAN for verification, and the taxpayer must archive the XML and visual representation for the statutory retention period of five years.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under art. 481 of the Estatuto Tributario and art. 1.6.1.12.6 of Decree 1625/2016, payment gateway and merchant acquiring services qualify for 0% VAT when: (1) the direct recipient of the service is a non-resident entity without domicile or tax residence in Colombia (e.g., a US acquiring bank, foreign PSP parent, or foreign online merchant); (2) the service is effectively used, enjoyed, or commercially exploited exclusively abroad, meaning the authorization, clearing, settlement, and gateway traffic are rendered for foreign cardholders and the benefit accrues in the foreign jurisdiction, not within Colombia; (3) the services are not performed to circumvent territorial rules designed to benefit Colombian residents; (4) the operation is documented with the Declaración de Exportación de Servicios (DES) filed in MUISCA and the export invoice is marked 'Exenta - exportación de servicios'; and (5) the consideration is received through Colombian foreign exchange channels (Declaración de Cambio or compensated accounts) within the applicable 180-day repatriation term. For cross-border acquiring on Visa/Mastercard rails and Fedwire clearing, the service is deemed an export of services because the Colombian entity operates as a back-office processing and settlement hub for foreign-originated transactions, with no Colombian end-consumer as direct beneficiary of the service.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Declaración de Exportación de Servicios (DES) Form 204, validated electronically in MUISCA before or within the allowed filing window, indicating the service classification under the Export Services Registry and the ISIC 6619 activity
Factura Electrónica de Venta (FEV) with CUNE and QR code, expressly marked 'Exenta - Exportación de Servicios - art. 481 E.T.' referencing the DES number

Commercial contract or intercompany service agreement executed with the foreign customer, identifying the exact service scope (merchant acquiring, clearing, gateway processing), payment currency, fees, and service levels
Certificate of non-residence of the foreign recipient, e.g., W-8BEN-E or foreign tax authority residency certificate, plus bank account proof of the overseas PSP entity
Formulario de Declaración de Cambio (FX return) issued by the Colombian intermediary bank or the Foreign Exchange Worksheet for inflows representing the export settlement
Inward remittance certificate and bank statements evidencing receipt of USD through the Colombian financial market or the compensation account, with matching invoice numbers
Technical documentation of the processing flows (logs, transaction counts, route diagrams) proving that the service is exclusively for foreign counterparties and not consumed in Colombia
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN audits export zero-rating rigorously and may retroactively revert the operation to domestic taxable service, assessing full 19% IVA plus monthly default interest (art. 634 E.T.) and an inexact statement penalty of up to 200% of the tax evaded (art. 648 E.T.) if the DES, e-invoice, or FX settlement documentation is absent or inconsistent; failure to repatriate foreign currency within 180 days violates the Colombian foreign exchange regime and voids the export treatment, triggering immediate VAT assessment, a fine of 5% of the non-repatriated sum for non-compliance, and potential exclusion from the exporter's registry for two to five years. Willful fraudulent zero-rating, especially with fabricated documentation, constitutes tax fraud under art. 402 of the Colombian Criminal Code, punishable with 4 to 9 years of imprisonment and disqualification of the legal representative's electronic signature ('Firma'), and Law 2277/2022 extends the tax limitation window to 10 years in cases involving transfers to low-tax jurisdictions or hybrid arrangements.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (central bank and foreign exchange administrator) in coordination with the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) for licensing, prudential, and AML/CFT supervision, and with DIAN for tax and customs interfaces. The operative FX instruments are Resolución Externa No. 8 of 2000 (as amended) and the consolidated Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83 of the Banco de la República, which together codify the Mercado Cambiario (MCR) regime; the UIAF (Unidad de Información y Análisis Financiero) receives suspicious-transaction reports.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: COP is fully convertible for current-account operations, but all payments for imports of goods and services, dividends, interest, and royalties must be canalized through the MCR, meaning they must be settled through an authorized local intermediary bank with an electronic Declaración de Cambio. Capital-account flows require registration rather than prior license: foreign direct investment is registered on Formulario No. 5 (Declaración de Cambio por Inversión Internacional) and external credit on Formulario No. 6 (Endeudamiento Externo), both filed by the intermediary bank within 15 calendar days of canalización. Profit and dividend remittance to non-resident shareholders is permitted without central-bank authorization, but the remitting bank conditions disbursement on (i) valid registration of the foreign investment, (ii) evidence that the applicable dividend withholding tax was withheld and paid to DIAN, and (iii) compliance status of the S.A.S. with tax filings; no convertibility quota or repatriation approval exists.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Colombian law imposes no mandatory conversion ratio and no surrender of export proceeds to the central bank. The obligation is canalización: export proceeds must be credited through the MCR to a Colombian resident account, either in COP or in foreign currency, and the foreign currency may be retained in deposit accounts with authorized local banks or in a previously registered Cuenta de Compensación abroad. For goods exports the channeling term follows the export deadline declared in Formulario No. 2; for cross-border services, including the PSP payment-processing model, each USD settlement batch from Visa/Mastercard or Fedwire must be canalized immediately upon receipt and declared by the intermediary on Formulario No. 4 (Declaración de Cambio por Exportación de Servicios) within 5 business days; failure to canalize exposes the S.A.S. to fines and FX-return sanctions.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility for outsourcing custody or MCR intermediation: Colombia does not recognize foreign EMI licenses (UK FCA or EU e-money) as a substitute for a local banking or SEDPE license. A cross-border PSP structurally must either (i) obtain SFC authorization as a Sociedad Especializada en Depósitos y Pagos Electrónicos (SEDPE) under Decreto 2555/2010, (ii) partner with a licensed local bank or SEDPE to hold merchant settlement funds, or (iii) operate purely as a technical acquiring switch without custody of client funds. Offshore EMIs may act only as downstream Visa/Mastercard acquiring and technology providers; they cannot open COP accounts, cannot access the MCR, and cannot hold Colombian merchant funds without triggering SARLAFT and SFC licensing obligations.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of directors is not an absolute statutory mandate, but a live KYC interview of the legal representative, compliance officer, and UBO chain is effectively mandatory under Circular Básica Jurídica SARLAFT rules; newly incorporated S.A.S. entities in high-risk ISIC 6619 activity are escalated to an in-branch interview of the legal representative and one alternate director in Bogotá or Medellín. The legal representative may be a non-resident, yet a Colombian resident agent with notarized power of attorney is operationally indispensable for bank correspondence, FX form signatures, and SWIFT instruction authentication; all foreign corporate documents must be apostilled, legally translated into Spanish, and presented within 90 days.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly incorporated S.A.S. (less than six months old) with foreign shareholders, no audited local financial history, and high-risk payment-gateway activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificado de Cámara de Comercio issued within 90 days; registered bylaws and stock registry; NIT and RUT certificates; board minutes appointing the legal representative; sworn UBO declaration with passport copies; parent company good-standing certificate and audited IFRS equity statements; 12-month cash-flow projections; projected settlement volumes and merchant jurisdiction list.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PSP business model generating third-party fund flows, multi-jurisdiction merchants, and elevated chargeback exposure, including prohibited categories (gambling, forex, crypto, digital goods).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Written end-to-end transaction flow diagram naming the receiving bank as first counterparty; merchant underwriting and monitoring policy; explicit prohibited-merchant list; chargeback and refund management procedure; PCI DSS attestation (SAQ-D or Level 1); SOC 2 Type 2 report; SFC-aligned SARLAFT manual; evidence of UIAF reporting design (ROS/ROI) and appointed compliance officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owners or parent entities domiciled in offshore tax havens, or UBOs with PEP or adverse-media background.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized and apostilled sworn UBO declaration identifying all natural persons holding more than 10% beneficial interest; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds letters supported by bank references from home-country institutions; independent sanctions and adverse-media screening results dated within 30 days (OFAC, EU, UIAF); documented PEP status and legitimacy of funds; full corporate chain chart to natural persons.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Perceived lack of physical substance in Colombia for a licensed PSP (no office, insufficient staff, no local auditor or systems).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered lease or shared-services agreement for the Bogotá office; payroll and EPS/ARL enrollments for at least three employees; Revisor Fiscal engagement letter if statutory thresholds are met; local data-processing and cardholder-data residency agreement; information-security policy; prior bank statements evidencing operational activity in the S.A.S. name.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity injection must arrive by SWIFT MT103 from the registered foreign shareholder to the S.A.S. operational COP or USD account at the chosen bank, with remittance information stating 'capital contribution', the beneficiary NIT, and the ISIC code 6619. The receiving bank files Formulario No. 5 with Banco de la República within 15 calendar days of canalización; the credit is booked as inward FDI only if the remitter matches the registered shareholder and the stated activity code is consistent with the payment-gateway scope. Shareholder loans with tenor exceeding one year require Formulario No. 6 (external credit) registration before repayment; shorter intercompany loans are recorded as other operations and must be settled through the MCR. The S.A.S. must record the capital subscription in notarized shareholders' minutes and in the stock registry before funds are operational; USD funds received on an unregistered account trigger outbound re-declaration obligations.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Local merchant payouts in Colombia are cleared through ACH Colombia (CENIT/Transfiya low-value clearing) or through SITRED, the Banco de la República real-time gross settlement system, in COP. Cross-border payouts to foreign merchants or suppliers are executed by SWIFT MT103 from the COP or USD account, with the intermediary bank declaring each operation on Formulario No. 3 (Declaración de Cambio por Importación de Servicios) when the outflow finances services, preserving FX symmetry with the service-export income. For commercial goods transactions, the bank can issue documentary letters of credit under UCP 600 (MT700 issue, MT707 amendment, MT202 cover) with document examination under ISBP 745. USD clearing to the United States (Fedwire target rail) runs through the tier-1 bank's U.S. correspondent network (Citibank N.A. or Bank of New York Mellon); Visa/Mastercard Direct settlement is absorbed into the PSP's USD deposit account and subsequently canalized into the MCR.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable COP/USD foreign-exchange forwards (contratos a plazo) executed over the MCR with authorized local banks; admissible when supported by underlying commercial exposure (settlement pipeline or cross-border investment); standard tenors up to 12 months with roll-over rights.

Offshore non-deliverable COP/USD forwards (NDFs) referencing the Tasa Representativa del Mercado (TRM) and cash-settled in USD outside Colombia; usable by the foreign parent or offshore derivatives desk without MCR intermediation.

Cross-currency swaps (COP/USD CCS) combining initial and final exchange of principal with COP floating legs referenced to IBR and USD floating legs referenced to SOFR; acceptable for hedging long-term FDI and intercompany loans, subject to Banco de la República derivative position reporting.
Short-term domestic FX swaps executed OTC with the local intermediary bank to align settlement currencies on monthly payout cycles, delivered through the MCR and settled via SITRED in COP.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil - annual renewal of the commercial registration with the Chamber of Commerce
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the entity's registered seat (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A 5% surcharge on the registry fee accrues for each month or fraction of delay; failure to renew for two consecutive years triggers cancellation of the commercial registration and loss of standing, plus fines of up to approx. USD 4,700 from the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements approved by the shareholders and deposited with the commercial registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders' meeting; copy filed with the Cámara de Comercio under Law 222 of 1995
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders' meeting no later than 31 March (within 3 months after the 31 December fiscal-year end); same date for the registry deposit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to approve and file the financial statements subjects the manager and directors to fines of up to approx. USD 4,700 and personal liability for unapproved distributions; the Superintendencia de Sociedades may order the filing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración de Renta y Complementarios (Form 110) - annual corporate income tax return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN - Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (electronic filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in April per DIAN calendar based on the last two digits of the NIT (for fiscal year 2024: 9-22 April 2025)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fine equals 5% of the tax due per month, capped at 100% of tax (minimum approx. USD 260); late-payment interest accrues at roughly 1.5% per month; non-filing can lead to presumed-income assessments and criminal tax evasion liability.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Información Exógena - annual information return of third-party payments, withholding and merchant settlement data (DIAN format 2276)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN via secure electronic file transmission
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually between May and June following the tax year (example: 9 May-28 June 2024 for fiscal year 2023)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or erroneous filing incurs a fine of 5% of the unreported amounts, subject to a minimum of approx. USD 95 and a maximum of approx. USD 9,300, under Article 651 of the Tax Code, plus potential disqualification of the PSP's tax compliance certificate.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Actualización Anual de Beneficiarios Finales (annual UBO update) and annotation of share transfers exceeding 10%
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (UBO electronic module) and the Cámara de Comercio (RUES shareholder register)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual update mandatory between 1 July and 31 July; share transfers reported within 30 days of transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: DIAN may fine up to approx. USD 3,500 for failure to update or for incomplete UBO disclosures; false beneficiary information exposes the company and its representatives to UIAF/SIC anti-money-laundering sanctions and criminal investigation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración Anual de Industria y Comercio (ICA) - cumulative annual municipal business and services tax return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Municipal treasury of the registered seat (e.g., Secretaría Distrital de Hacienda de Bogotá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in the second half of April (Bogotá example: 22 April 2025 for fiscal year 2024)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Municipal late-payment interest of approximately 1.5% per month, surcharges of 5-10% of the tax due, fines up to 100% of the unpaid ICA, and coercive collection that blocks licenses and certificate renewals.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent audit and mandatory Revisor Fiscal are required when, at the prior 31 December, the S.A.S. has total assets of at least 5,000 UVT (COP 225.0m for 2024; COP 249.0m for 2025), gross revenue of at least 3,000 UVT (COP 135.0m for 2024; COP 149.4m for 2025), or more than 20 employees; payment gateways licensed by the Superintendencia Financiera require a Revisor Fiscal and statutory audit regardless of these thresholds.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Full IFRS as adopted in Colombia (NIIF Plenas, Decrees 2784/2012 and 2496/2015) applies to SFC-supervised payment processors and companies of public interest; smaller S.A.S. entities may apply NIIF para PYMES (Decree 3022/2013) or the micro-entity framework (Decree 2706/2012); all statutory financial statements are expressed in COP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Each S.A.S. must annually confirm its ultimate beneficial owners in the DIAN UBO application during the 1-31 July window. A beneficial owner is any natural person who directly or indirectly holds 10% or more of the equity interest or exercises control. The protocol requires the company to annotate any share transfer in the shareholders register within 30 days and to trace intermediary legal structures until the natural-person owner is identified for each transfer; failure to keep this confirmation current blocks RUT certificates and exposes the company to fines.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Registro de Accionistas y de Transferencias de Acciones (shareholders register with transfer and pledge annotations)
Libro de Actas de Asamblea General y de Junta Directiva (minutes books of shareholder and board meetings)
Libros de Contabilidad: Diario, Mayor, Inventarios y Balances (accounting books registered with the Cámara de Comercio)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 300-1,200 per year for registered office, domicile services, and a local legal representative/agent
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,500-10,000 per year for the Revisor Fiscal and IFRS statutory audit of a mid-size payment gateway

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% for general corporate taxpayers for fiscal years 2024 and 2025; 38% for a Colombian SAS classified as a regulated financial entity (SEDPE) due to the temporary 3-percentage-point surcharge under Law 2277 of 2022; the general rate reverts to 30% from fiscal year 2026.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory income tax holiday is available for payment gateway operators. Applicable preferential regimes and deductions include: (i) a 20% corporate income tax rate for companies domiciled in Free Trade Zones; (ii) an 80% additional deduction on qualified investments in science, technology and innovation under Article 158-1 of the Tax Code; (iii) exemption for dividends from Colombian-source profits when distributed to Colombian resident corporate shareholders; and (iv) indefinite carryforward of tax losses, subject to a 25% annual utilization cap.
